verdicts.reason: A keeps the headline large and readable and the bottle at a usable size, but it drops the cream circle behind the bottle, moves the product from the left lead to the middle-right, and stacks the NEW pill tight against the Try It button with almost no gap. B keeps NEW and Try It side by side like the original, but shrinks the product to a tiny circle jammed into the top-right corner against the canvas edge, so the key image becomes trivial and the right end looks cramped.
